“Not all men (and especially the wisest) share the opinion that it…” — Christine de Pizan (Q0543)

An English quotation associated with The Book of the City of Ladies (1405), I.27, organized here under education.

Quotes / Christine de Pizan / Q0543

Not all men (and especially the wisest) share the opinion that it is bad for women to be educated.

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with The Book of the City of Ladies (1405), I.27, within the Renaissance Humanism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of education, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Christine de Pizan's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
